turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hello there! How's your day treating you?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: So I'm switching from one phone system to the other and I'm worried my contacts won't come over.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: They almost always do. Contacts live in your account, so if they're synced, they'll come across when you sign in.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: How do I know if they're synced?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Go to your contacts settings on the old phone and see which account they're saved to. If it says on device, they're only on the phone itself.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: It says on device for, like,

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Then move those to your account first. There's usually an option to export or move contacts in that same menu.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Messages are trickier between systems. The setup app on the new phone usually offers to copy them, so use it during the first setup rather than afterwards.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Okay. I'll do it all on Saturday with a cup of tea.
